intro_line: Chennai blends colonial heritage, temple bells and long Marina sands.
intro: Chennai rewards visitors with grand temples, colonial architecture, fiery South Indian food and a lively beachfront. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Chennai Metro Blue and Green lines link the airport, Alandur and MGR Chennai Central; fares run ₹10-60.
A one-day Tourist Travel Card costs ₹100, with ₹50 refunded on return.
MTC city buses are very cheap, roughly ₹4-30; deluxe and AC buses cost more.
Daily and weekly bus passes cost about ₹50 and ₹300 on normal and deluxe routes.
Suburban trains are fast and cheap, from ₹5; buy first class at peak times.
Ola and Uber work well and are usually cheaper than prepaid taxis; autos use meters or negotiate.

airports.name: Chennai International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, about 15-19 km south-west of the centre.
